about_short_description.short_description: Easy to use Kubernetes PaaS for individual developers and small teams!

product.name: KubeSail Kubernetes PaaS
product.description: A platform that enables individual developers and small teams to deploy and manage Kubernetes clusters easily, supporting self-hosting on various hardware including home servers and cloud.

product.name: PiBox
product.description: A Raspberry Pi powered NAS device pre-installed with Kubernetes and KubeSail agent, designed for easy self-hosting of applications and storage at home or office.

product.name: KubeSail Backups
product.description: A service to create scheduled or manual encrypted backups of data within Kubernetes clusters, with cloud storage options for self-hosted applications.

product.name: KubeSail Dynamic DNS and Tunneling
product.description: A service that provides automatic dynamic DNS updates and secure tunneling to expose self-hosted applications to the internet without manual router configuration.

product.name: KubeSail Templates and App Store
product.description: A collection of Kubernetes application templates that users can deploy to their clusters, facilitating easy installation and management of common self-hosted software.
